title: Recording: Maisie by Wings | 1978
content:
Spirit of Ranachan Studio, Low Ranachan Farm, Campbeltown, Scotland
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tim Summerhayes

Wings recorded the Laurence Juber song ‘Maisie’ on 21 July 1978.

Paul McCartney had encouraged the other members of Wings to contribute songs to the Back To The Egg album, and Juber came back with the Chet Atkins-style instrumental.

The recording featured Juber on Gibson Super 400 guitar, McCartney on Rickenbacker bass guitar, Denny Laine on harmonica, and Steve Holley on drums.

‘Maisie’ was taken no further by Wings, and was not mixed for the album.
